title: The affine Bernstein theorem in dimensions three through nine
summary: We prove the Euclidean-complete affine Bernstein conjecture in dimensions three through nine: a smooth locally uniformly convex affine maximal graph is an elliptic paraboloid whenever its induced Euclidean metric is complete. The same conclusion holds, without an initial graph assumption, for connected smooth open (noncompact and without boundary) affine-complete locally uniformly convex immersed hypersurfaces that are classically affine maximal in these dimensions.
family_title: Affine Bernstein rigidity through dimension nine and a smooth dimension-ten counterexample

review.reason: Proves an affine Bernstein theorem for complete affine maximal graphs in dimensions three to nine.
